TEST-RUNNER pass (WF-02 Step 4) for REQ-170. Design, security-review, reviewer, and test-design-validator gates have all passed. Run the FULL suite (not just the wasm subdirectory) and report real results. Use export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" and WASMEX_BUILD=true for wasmex-touching commands. Attribute any failure structurally before concluding it's unrelated to this branch's diff -- never by count-matching. Be aware of ISS-0287 (Postgres pool-exhaustion recurrence) and ISS-0351 (WASM registry timeout-path CPU-spin) as known background issues.

result.summary: All 4 acceptance criteria verified with real output. (1) mix compile --force --warnings-as-errors: 'Compiling 135 files (.ex)' / 'Generated letflow app', exit 0, clean. (2) mix test test/letflow/engine/wasm/: 'Result: 98 passed', 0 failures -- matches expected 98 (call_timeout 16 + plugin_handler extended + resource_limits 12 + memory_guard 18 + capability_gate 18 + module_registry 20); the 5 logged 'GenServer.call ... (EXIT) time out' Task errors during this run are call_timeout's own intentional timeout assertions (hang/300/2000/500/7000ms scenarios), not failures -- confirmed by the 0-failures result. Did not run or reproduce the 32-concurrent-hang saturation scenario from the design doc's section 1.5, per the SAFETY NOTE. (3) Full suite via scripts/test_parallel.sh (N=8, nproc-derived, foreground/blocking): partitions 1-8 each reported exit 0 with 0 failures; combined: 2381 tests, 5 properties, 0 failures (2386/2386 passed). No pool-exhaustion (ISS-0287) or WASM registry timeout-path CPU-spin (ISS-0351) symptoms observed -- all partitions completed promptly with clean exits, so neither background issue surfaced in this run. (4) mix letflow.lint_handoffs: 'OK -- 0 new violations across 1272 handoff files (25 pre-existing grandfathered, traced to ISS-0190)'; none of the flagged pre-existing items are in this run's handoff file. Environment notes: postgres/keycloak containers were already up (docker compose commands required sudo -n, which succeeded non-interactively) on port 5463 per this checkout's untracked .env (LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5463), consistent with README's per-workspace-port guidance -- no collision risk with other checkouts. mix deps.get succeeded (network available); a security-advisory notice for EEF-CVE-2026-74836 (Bandit/Plug HTTP2 window starvation) printed during deps.get is pre-existing dependency-advisory noise unrelated to this branch's diff, not a test failure. No report file written under test/reports/ since this was a clean pass end to end (per the test-runner instructions, a clean pass needs no report file). Conclusion: REQ-170's WASM engine work is fully green at both the targeted subdirectory and full-suite level; ready for RELEASE-VALIDATOR's independent re-run.
